# ankra_stack_profile_version (Resource)

A published version of a stack profile: an immutable snapshot of `stack_name` on `source_cluster_id`, which becomes the profile's current version. The counterpart of `ankra stack-profiles save-version`, `deprecate` and `undeprecate`.

Versions are immutable, so changing what a version was made from publishes a new one. The platform cannot delete a published version: destroying this resource only removes it from state, and the version stays in the profile's history. Withdraw a version from new deployments with `deprecation` instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_stack_profile_version" "cert_manager_bump" {
  profile_id        = ankra_stack_profile.platform.id
  source_cluster_id = "3f0c6c1e-8a4b-4f39-9d55-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
  stack_name        = "platform"
  changelog         = "cert-manager 1.16"
}

resource "ankra_stack_profile_version" "withdrawn" {
  profile_id        = ankra_stack_profile.platform.id
  source_cluster_id = "3f0c6c1e-8a4b-4f39-9d55-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
  stack_name        = "platform-legacy"

  deprecation = {
    reason     = "cve"
    note       = "Upgrade to the current version."
    references = ["CVE-2026-1234"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profile_id` (String) Profile the version is published to.
- `source_cluster_id` (String) Cluster whose stack is snapshotted. Changing it publishes a new version.
- `stack_name` (String) Stack on `source_cluster_id` that is snapshotted. Changing it publishes a new version.

### Optional

- `changelog` (String) What changed in this version.
- `channel` (String) Release channel. Defaults to `stable`.
- `deprecation` (Attributes) Withdraws the version from new deployments. Unset clears it. The platform refuses to deprecate the profile's current version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deprecation))
- `include_addon_configurations` (Boolean) Whether the version carries the add-ons' configuration values. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the version was published.
- `id` (String) `<profile_id>/<version>`.
- `version` (Number) The version number the platform assigned.
- `version_id` (String) Identifier of the version row.

<a id="nestedatt--deprecation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deprecation`

Required:

- `reason` (String) `incompatibility`, `critical_bug` or `cve`.

Optional:

- `note` (String) What deployers should do instead (at most 2000 characters).
- `references` (List of String) Advisory identifiers or URLs (at most 20).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Versions are imported as <profile_id>/<version>.
terraform import ankra_stack_profile_version.cert_manager_bump 7b1d2c3e-4f5a-6b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e/2
```
